mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (shop_id, category_id, dish_name, price, image_url, description, stock, status) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{categoryId}, #{dishName}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{stock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET shop_id = #{dish.shopId}, category_id = #{dish.categoryId}, dish_name = #{dish.dishName}, price = #{dish.price}, image_url = #{dish.imageUrl}, description = #{dish.description}, stock = #{dish.stock}, status = #{dish.status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dish SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
